test_title: PYST 42: SSC GD Constable 2025 - English (Held On: 25 Feb, 2025 - Shift 3)
subject: english
question: Identify the sentence with the INCORRECT usage of an adverb.

options.text: He called his friend last night.
I will send you the report tomorrow.
I’ll submit next week the assignment to you.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The issue in Option 4 lies in the incorrect placement of the adverb **"next week."**
 
• Adverbs of time, such as "next week," are typically placed at the beginning or the end of the sentence for clarity.
 
• The correct sentence should be: **"I'll submit the assignment to you next week."**
 
• This ensures proper sentence structure and grammatic
